site.title: Coping
site.tagline: Skate and surf, Gloucester Road, Brighton

posts.title: Nia Campbell, Brighton part
posts.content:
Four minutes, filmed over one summer between the Level and the seafront. Filmed and edited by Jonny Kerr. Premiere night at the shop on 23 October.

Watch it on YouTube

posts.title: Jonny Kerr at Hove Lagoon, raw files
posts.content: Twelve minutes of unedited bowl runs, slams included. No music, just wheels on concrete.

posts.title: Couch session with Aisha
posts.content: Aisha filmed a whole part in her flat during the rain in March. The couch did not survive.

posts.title: Our own decks are back from the press
posts.content: Two widths, 8.0 and 8.5, pressed in Portugal from seven-ply maple. Free grip, fitted at the counter.

posts.title: Pushing to Shoreham and back
posts.content: Sol pushed a cruiser along the coast road to Shoreham and back, 14 miles. We filmed from a bike. It took most of a Sunday.

posts.title: Winter surf days, what we rent and when
posts.content: Board rental from the seafront hut runs until the end of October, then by appointment. Winter wetsuits are 5/4, and we have eight to lend.
